negativeControls.startup: Raw UI3 host, wrong fingerprint, changed roots, changed read keys, storage write operation, wrong namespace, wrong pinned scope and writable config were refused before opening the store.
negativeControls.release: Wrong organization, project, app, environment, platform, runtime, namespace, permissions and limits were refused. Altered manifest, assignment and payload, missing signature, and artifact key used for assignment were refused.
negativeControls.withoutEnrollment: Fresh and replayed publish refused. Replayed rollback refused. Persisted update offer returned 204, and public and authorized artifact reads returned 404. Re-enrollment restored sequence 3.
negativeControls.durability: All rejected requests left the stored release.json bytes unchanged.

scope: Local Go origin and ordinary CLI. The operator pins the exact installed read policy separately from the signed namespace grant. The installed storage adapter handles key enforcement. Worker, Phoenix and native adoption were outside the run.
